import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue';
import ui from '@nuxt/ui/vite';
import { config } from './package.json';
import { notices } from './scripts/notices';

export default defineConfig({
  base: `/views/${config.webview.id}/`,
  plugins: [vue(), ui({
    dts: false,
    colorMode: false,
    ui: { colors: { primary: 'emerald', neutral: 'slate' } },
    // Dynamic icon names are not always found by scanning. Bundle them locally:
    // the portable server deliberately blocks remote icon requests.
    icon: { clientBundle: { icons: ['lucide:bookmark', 'lucide:check', 'lucide:search'] } },
  }), notices()],
  build: { outDir: 'dist', sourcemap: false },
});
